decisions.summary: Rack-by-the-house knob is HamletSpec.harvest_weather (settled|changeable), set from the spec, never rolled; default settled; other engines draw no rack; entry 500's drying-method knob folded into it.
decisions.why: Unchanged from round 1. FR-005: entry 505 finds the environment decided, so the knob is set from an environment input the spec states, pinnable, one knob with 500's; the GM's worry about adjacent villages in one climate differing is what this prevents.

decisions.summary: Sawada declares harvest_weather=changeable as the pool's exhibit; the other four hamlets keep none.
decisions.why: Unchanged. An exhibit choice inside FR-005/FR-008; some settlements have racks and some do not, as the GM asked.

decisions.summary: Mats tiled in 6 x 3 ft cells in rows with a gap around each (2 ft, closing a step at a time where a yard would fall under a third), count held to [ceil(full/3), floor(2 full/3)], center mat and rim line dropped; rows a GUESS, the gapped thinning a CONVENTION.
decisions.why: Round 3: the checkered half replaced by gapped rows (it read as pavers). Still FR-004 as written: mats over the whole yard, fewer than cover it, in rows labeled a guess, the band [1/3, 2/3] of a full cover unchanged, every quarter carrying mats - both held by test_yard_mats_282.py. Nothing narrowed. Note: plan text says the gap closes to 1.5 then 1 ft and the ceiling comes from the 1 ft pitch; yards.py MAT_GAPS_FT is (2, 1.5, 1, 0.5, 0) with even thinning where edge to edge overshoots two thirds - a description lag, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: Rack along a side edge, preferring the half nearest the house, always off the yard's MAP-south half (solved in map coordinates for any rotation), 2.5 ft drawn width, side by _hjit, mats skip its footprint, manifest records it.
decisions.why: FR-006: off the southern half and the corridor, map south not local south, the side a labeled guess (505: sources silent). The GM: racks should not be at the south side of the yard.

decisions.summary: Where neither side's near-house half leaves 4 ft, the whole side edge is tried, still off the map-south half; every yard on a changeable-weather map takes a rack, asserted by a Sawada test.
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE item is resolved: the project's guess (the near half) now yields instead of the per-map knob, and no household on a rack map loses its rack. The GM's hard rule (never on the south side) is kept. The 'always' claim holds by arithmetic on the recorded constants (checked 2026-09-28 by reading yards.py): YARD_MIN_TSUBO 8 at YARD_ASPECT 1.45 gives a depth of about 14 ft, so the near half alone leaves 5 ft past the 2 ft inset, above RACK_MIN_FT 4, and rack_segment's clip always leaves at least h/2 - inset on the better side under any rotation. The Sawada every-yard test enforces the request and is not scope.

Regenerate the five pool hamlets; settlement-review on Sawada paired with the gate; make done.
